name: pulumi-debug-failed-operation
description: Debug a Pulumi update or preview that failed: read the failure Pulumi already recorded, find what caused it, and fix it. Load this skill when the user asks to debug, diagnose, or fix a failed update or preview, or points at a failing `pulumi up` or `pulumi preview`. Don't load it for authoring new infrastructure, migrations, or provider upgrades; those have their own skills.
